supported_certificate_types.DTI: Department of Trade and Industry — Business Name Registration
supported_certificate_types.CDA: Cooperative Development Authority — Certificate of Registration
supported_certificate_types.DSWD: Department of Social Welfare and Development — NGO Accreditation

security_features: Official dry seal or wet seal
notes: DTI certificates are typically landscape A4 or half-A4 paper. CDA and DSWD certificates may be portrait A4. The expected_name field should contain the registered organisation/business name for comparison. The expected_dob field is not applicable for this document type and will be skipped in flagging.
